name: @kitchensink/remote-search-infra
//: ⛔ NOT AN npm WORKSPACE, like every CDK directory: `aws-cdk-lib` installs here and never enters the root tree.
⚠️ `@kitchensink/usda-client` and `@kitchensink/schema-remote-search` are IMPORTED but not DECLARED: they are
unpublished workspace packages, so declaring them would make `npm install` here resolve them from the registry and
404. Node finds them by walking up to the repo root. Same trade as every other CDK directory.

scripts.deploy: npm run bundle:lambda --prefix .. && cdk deploy --app 'npx tsx bin/app.ts'
scripts.synth: npm run bundle:lambda --prefix .. && cdk synth --app 'npx tsx bin/app.ts'

localSandbox.skipSynth: the remote search service is deployed where food is, at `prod` and once per pull request, so its app refuses every other stage, the local one included; a local run reaches the real handler through its own LOCAL e2e tier, never through this stack.
